title: Merge Intervals
keyIdea: Sort by start. Walk the intervals keeping the merged list: if the next interval starts after the last merged one ends, it starts a new group; otherwise it overlaps, so stretch the last end to max(end, its end).

approaches.name: Sort and merge
approaches.idea: Your code: sort, then push a new interval or extend ans.back()[1].
approaches.why: The sort dominates; one pass after it. The answer list can hold n intervals.

options: The new interval may sit entirely inside the last one, like [1,10] and [2,3]
